zh: 本页保留 R0.61 到 R0.73R 的全部 134 个节点。R0.61–R0.69W 从约化递推走到严格环带排除；R0.70A–R0.71Z 检查移动尺度、临界账本、内部 entry 与 complete-root 边界；R0.72A–R0.73B 处理 strong coupling、critical log、碰撞几何与完整线性 Fourier--Leray 行；R0.73C–I 依次处理冻结 Rayleigh 不稳定、黏性谱簇持续、固定正半平面传递、移动剖面增益、非线性相对放大、平面固定距离偏离与零窗口作用量边界。R0.73J 认证无黏连续谱支，R0.73K 闭合参数一致的黏性 rank-one 谱支，R0.73L 把冻结谱支升级为真实非自治 selected action；R0.73M 再用完整 action 指定种子，并在固定物理时刻闭合二维非线性固定距离偏离。背景随 \(\Lambda\) 改变，轨道留在精确二维不变子空间；prefactor 极限、两项 WKB、固定背景、横向三维、奇性与 Clay 没有被外推。 R0.73M 证明：当 \(\Lambda\to\infty\) 且背景随之改变时，按完整作用量 缩小的平面扰动可以在固定时刻保持固定阶输出。R0.73N 补上固定成员审计： 任意共存强解满足有限累积应变控制；平面扰动全局满足 \(L^2\) 稳定估计； 足够小的全三维 \(H^3\) 扰动落在正的全局强解稳定管内。因此，R0.73M 中的量词顺序不能交换为一个固定背景上的任意小输入、固定距离逃逸。 R0.73O 关闭了已知全局无强迫背景上的 \(H^3\)-小扰动不稳定路线：每条轨道最终衰减，累积 \(H^4\) 作用量有限，并有一个对所有起始时刻有效的正稳定半径。强迫对照保留无限累积应变，并由平面方向给出全局光滑、初始 \(H^3\) 趋零而输出固定 \(L^2\) 逃逸的见证。 R0.73P 关闭了固定全局强轨道周围的临界稳定与带限输入接口：临界管对所有起始时刻有效，\(N^{-1/2}\) 指数对范数转移精确，并允许 \(L^2\) 趋零而 \(H^3\) 发散的光滑扰动。能量球内所有弱分支在共同延迟后正则并相对参考轨道同步；不能跨越的部分是此前的早期弱区间。 这一节用周期 Stokes--HLS 双线性估计和有限 Volterra 递推，构造了一个全起点统一的临界热流稳定管。精确 Fourier 族证明它加入了旧 \(H^{1/2}\) 管之外的光滑安全数据；裸 Kato 上确界则被一个时间端点反例阻断。whole-space Besov 开放性属于已知文献，Clay 结论仍开放。 我把 R0.73R 的当前价值评为“可靠的桥接引理与反例工具”，而不是高水平正则性主定理。可保留之处是：分层拆开能量、加法几何与高阶相位；给出有限 Fourier 数据可复算的严格证书；用同谱确定性族证明二次能谱不足。
en: This page retains, from R0.61 through R0.73R, all 134 nodes. R0.61–R0.69W moved from reduced recurrences to rigorous annular exclusion; R0.70A–R0.71Z examined moving scales, the critical ledger, the internal entry, and the complete-root boundary; R0.72A–R0.73B treated strong coupling, critical log, collision geometry, and the complete linear Fourier--Leray row; R0.73C–I then treated frozen Rayleigh instability, persistence of viscous spectral clusters, transfer into a fixed positive half-plane, moving-profile gains, nonlinear relative amplification, fixed-distance planar deviation, and the zero-window action boundary. R0.73J certified an inviscid continuous spectral branch, R0.73K closed a parameter-consistent viscous rank-one spectral branch, and R0.73L upgraded the frozen spectral branch to a genuine nonautonomous selected action; R0.73M then used the full action to select the seed and closed a two-dimensional nonlinear fixed-distance deviation at a fixed physical time. The background varies with \(\Lambda\), while the orbit remains in an exact two-dimensional invariant subspace; no extrapolation is made to the prefactor limit, two-term WKB, a fixed background, transverse three-dimensional perturbations, singularity, or Clay. R0.73M proves that, as \(\Lambda\to\infty\) and the background changes with it, planar perturbations scaled down by the full action can retain an order-one output at a fixed time. R0.73N adds the fixed-member audit: every coexisting strong solution obeys a finite accumulated-strain control; planar perturbations satisfy a global \(L^2\) stability estimate; and sufficiently small fully three-dimensional \(H^3\) perturbations lie inside a positive global strong-solution stability tube. Therefore, the quantifier order in R0.73M cannot be exchanged for arbitrarily small input on one fixed background with fixed-distance escape. R0.73O closes the \(H^3\)-small perturbation-instability route around known global unforced backgrounds: every orbit eventually decays, the accumulated \(H^4\) action is finite, and a positive stability radius works for every starting time. The forced comparison retains infinite accumulated strain and, through a planar direction, supplies a globally smooth witness whose initial \(H^3\) tends to zero while its output escapes by a fixed \(L^2\) distance. R0.73P closes the critical-stability and band-limited-input interfaces around a fixed global strong orbit: the critical tube works for every starting time, the \(N^{-1/2}\) exponent is exact for norm transfer, and smooth perturbations may have \(L^2\) tending to zero while \(H^3\) diverges. Every weak branch in the energy ball becomes regular after a common delay and synchronizes relative to the reference orbit; the part that cannot be crossed is the preceding early weak interval. This section uses the periodic Stokes--HLS bilinear estimate and a finite Volterra recurrence to construct a critical caloric stability tube uniform over all starting times. An exact Fourier family proves that it includes smooth safe data outside the old \(H^{1/2}\) tube; a time-endpoint counterexample blocks the bare Kato supremum. Whole-space Besov openness is established in the literature, while the Clay conclusion remains open. I assess the current value of R0.73R as a "reliable bridge lemma and counterexample tool," not as a high-level regularity theorem. Its retainable value is that it separates energy, additive geometry, and higher-order phase into distinct layers; provides a rigorous certificate recomputable from finite Fourier data; and uses a deterministic isospectral family to show that quadratic energy spectra are insufficient.

en: Neither the 134 nodes nor the 96 public versions can be interpreted as a percentage of Clay completion. Finite-time singularity and global regularity for arbitrary initial data remain OPEN.

zh: 我把 R0.73R 的当前价值评为“可靠的桥接引理与反例工具”，而不是高水平正则性主定理。可保留之处是：分层拆开能量、加法几何与高阶相位；给出有限 Fourier 数据可复算的严格证书；用同谱确定性族证明二次能谱不足。 下一关是 R0.73S：下一发布门 R0.73S 将优先检查：能否用部分自相关、低阶加法能量或 可分块相位图，构造复杂度明显低于精确三重卷积、同时严格支配 \(\Theta_j\) 的确定性代理量。若做不到，结果应以 no-go 或复杂度 下界形式发布。
en: I assess the current value of R0.73R as a "reliable bridge lemma and counterexample tool," not as a high-level regularity theorem. Its retainable value is that it separates energy, additive geometry, and higher-order phase into distinct layers; provides a rigorous certificate recomputable from finite Fourier data; and uses a deterministic isospectral family to show that quadratic energy spectra are insufficient. The next gate is R0.73S: the R0.73S release gate will first test whether partial autocorrelations, low-order additive energy, or blockwise phase graphs can produce a deterministic proxy that is substantially cheaper than exact triple convolution while still rigorously controlling \(\Theta_j\). If not, the result will be released as a no-go statement or a complexity lower bound.
